eval-bot: :rotating_light: NIGHTLY EVAL ALERT (2026-03-19 06:13 UTC) - suites failed: instruction-structout, json-schema-check, legal-snippet-cohort - primary symptom: structured outputs returning duplicated keys + stray HTML tags in citation/answer fields - candidate model: rwd/open-medium-v2 (quant4 int4) - failure rate: 8.3% on cohort 'formatting-heavy-v2' sample failing output:```json { "answer": "See the sources below.

", "answer": "See the sources below.", "citation": "doc", "confidence": "0.42" } ``` sana: I noticed this in the morning run, repros locally on int4 for me (~1/12 seeds). looks like either decoding/postprocess or quant path issue. mike: assigning to me for initial triage @sana — will take ownership. jordan: initial severity P2? This affects structured outputs used in downstream parsers. If rate jumps, escalate to P1. alexa: can we route affected suites to fp16/fp32 variants in hosted until we root cause? mike: triage plan: 1) reproduce failing promptset at scale 2) capture token-level probs + kv-cache dumps for int4 vs fp16 3) compare eval-harness postprocess output (is duplicate introduced pre/post) 4) try alternative decoding params (top_k/top_p/temp) 5) if not repro, run kernel-selection trace from runtime mike: pinging eng-runtime for model load flags, kernel selection and quant kernel versions used in nightly run @eng-runtime alexa: sample prompt ids that fail frequently: fmt-1245, fmt-1260, legal-202 — adding them to thread for triage. sana: stray HTML seems correlated with answers that referenced URLs. Could be generator producing raw html tags, or postprocess sanitization dropped. jordan: timeline — can we get initial findings in ~3 hours? need to notify product owners if we can't mitigate quickly. mike: yep aiming for a 3hr first-pass. quick mitigation in the meantime: route instruction-structout -> rwd/open-medium-v2-fp16 for hosted + dedicated canary. alexa: I'll add a canary routing rule now and update the console. :white_check_mark: mike: odd detail — duplicated JSON keys suggests multiple candidate merges into one JSON object (eval harness merge step). will instrument harness to dump intermediate generator outputs before postprocess. sana: tiny repro command I'm using: ```bash # repro sample python run_eval.py --model rwd/open-medium-v2 --quant int4 --suite instruction-structout --samples 20 --seed 42 ``` jordan: if harness is fine, then likely runtime decoding/kernel bug. will coordinate with eng-runtime. pinging @devex team to diff harness deploys. devex-bot: received ping from jordan; spinning up eval-harness diff job and will link results shortly. mike: owner: mike (initial). severity: P2. next update by 3h or earlier with repro logs/kvcache + sample diffs. sana: thanks — I'll keep monitoring overnight alerts and add any new failing prompt ids here. :pray:
